adjudication.rationale: The diff does remove the ability to create a group and set initial members in the same request/UI step: `Admin::GroupsController#create` now only reads `params[:name]`/`params[:visible]` and no longer processes usernames (previously `params[:group][:usernames]`), and the JS model `Discourse.Group#asJSON` similarly no longer includes `usernames`. In the admin template `group.hbs`, member list/add-member controls are gated behind `{{#if id}}`, so you can’t add members until after the group is created. The previously existing spec that asserted create-with-usernames behavior was removed/rewritten. This is a concrete, diff-grounded behavior/API change (potentially backward-incompatible), but not an internal correctness error given new separate `add_members`/`remove_member` endpoints were introduced.
